svg.title: Aero1553 - Class Diagram (Rust, Python, C++)
svg.text: The shared semantic model. The conformance suite under tests/conformance/ holds the three implementations to byte-exact CSV equivalence; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 1 maps the modules.

g.text: Merge, delta, filter, order (merge, delta, filter, order)

text.tspan: commit and commit_partial share one move
enforced AT the move by a non-replacing
Rust: one flat enum, MieError, whose variants match the
Python leaf classes one to one (FileIo <-> MieFileIoError).
The Mie*Error base classes are never raised -- they exist
to be caught. kind() returns a MieErrorKind discriminant.
MieFileError: true only for input I/O failures
rejections and destination guards answer false to both
predicates -- match on kind() for those.
